selection: first passing candidate; otherwise highest progress with support, report failure
transfer_eligibility: initial manual source/transition prefix boundary: module index >=6, excluding initially target-region modules
excluded_exploratory: horizontal/segmented_w4: geometric hole inside initial target prefix incorrectly counted as newly transferred module; initial diagnostic only
v1_*, v2_*: early-stop criterion incorrectly treated temporary loss of one pipe as whole-body detachment; retained as censored pilot data, not final comparisons
support_audit: 100 Hz; movement stops on floor contact or loss of ALL pipe contacts for 0.2 s, not loss of one pipe. Dual-pipe contact remains required for the final 3 s hold.
